recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for this issue; future secondary-finding terminology changes should be evaluated in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by restoring removed core files.
issue_request: FHIR-22829 asked to correct the copied Observation Category Codes name/title on the Secondary Findings code system and value set. Jira is Published with Persuasive resolution, Clinical Genomics work group, applied for R5.
initial_application: The issue was applied through PR #1844: merge commit 801c1796fa4098cda164c71a298abb645d180312 and implementation commit 985c5e919ceecdfdd60410ee01edfae3c70c5af1. That patch changed the secondary-finding ValueSet name/title from ObservationCategoryCodes/Observation Category Codes to GeneticObservationSecondaryFindings/Genetic Observation Secondary Findings and fixed the same description typo in the CodeSystem, ValueSet, and extension binding; the CodeSystem name/title were already GeneticObservationSecondaryFindings/Genetic Observation Secondary Findings at that point.
additional_context: CG minutes for 2020-08-18 record the FHIR-22829 block-vote approval and also list FHIR-20165, a same-meeting Published/Persuasive decision to remove deprecated genomics artifacts from core for R5. Current core has no active fhir.ini entry or source definition for secondary-finding; only OID registrations remain. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 deleted the core secondary-finding CodeSystem, ValueSet, and observation-secondaryFinding StructureDefinition as part of removing extensions from R5 source. The FHIR Extension Pack currently contains the secondary-finding CodeSystem and ValueSet with corrected Genetic Observation Secondary Findings titles and deprecates the associated extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source edit was made because the affected definitions are outside the current core build and the external Extension Pack copies already preserve the FHIR-22829 correction.

related_jiras.note: Same CG block vote and later Published/Persuasive context for removing deprecated genomics artifacts from core for R5; used only as context because it covers a broader artifact-removal scope.
